course_name: Radiation and its Effects on MicroElectronics and Photonics Technologies
faculty: Faculty of Mathematics and Science
duration: 2 years, 120 ECTS; an Erasmus Mundus Joint Master's Degree (RADMEP/RADMEP+) delivered with University Jean Monnet Saint-Etienne (coordinator), KU Leuven, and University of Montpellier - students spend semester 1 at JYU, semester 2 at KU Leuven, a 2-month summer internship, then semester 3 at either Montpellier (microelectronics) or Jean Monnet (photonics) before a 6-month thesis; JYU's own programme page publishes no fee figure at all and routes applicants to the external consortium site (master-radmep.org) for full details - per this project's sourcing rule, both fee sides are left null rather than using the off-domain consortium figure (third-party/aggregator sources report a programme-country vs partner-country tiered fee structure where even EU/programme-country students pay a fee, which would make this a genuine 'everyone pays' exception like other Erasmus Mundus programmes elsewhere in this project, but this could not be confirmed on jyu.fi itself so amount is null rather than 0 or a guessed figure); a JYU news article states the JYU Department of Physics (via its Accelerator Laboratory, JYFL-ACCLAB) is 'strongly linked' to the programme's research, but no page states the Department of Physics as the programme's formal owning unit, so the bare faculty name is used rather than that inference

Neither the general programme page nor its dedicated Studyinfo application page names an owning department more specific than the bare Faculty - third-party/course-listing evidence (Department of Music, Art and Culture Studies teaches several of its game-studies courses) was found but is not an explicit ownership statement on the programme's own page, so recorded at the Faculty level per this project's confirmed-unit rule rather than guessed
